title: palicourea scabrifolia
intro: Palicourea scabrifolia, commonly known as "Mangrove" or "Sarapuí" in Brazil, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Palicourea scabrifolia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its potential as a treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, such as quinovic acid and mangiferin, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
